item.title: Your ASP.NET Core Endpoints Don't Have a Timeout
item.description: ASP.NET Core doesn't enforce an application timeout on incoming requests by default. The built-in middleware can add one, but it only cancels RequestAborted. Link to article: https://milanjovanovic.tech/blog/your-aspnetcore-endpoints-dont-have-a-timeout
